title: Claude Code UI default authentication can be bypassed for WebSocket shell execution
summary: The third-party Claude Code UI combines a default JWT secret, incomplete WebSocket user validation and shell injection into unauthenticated code execution. A separate authenticated Git endpoint injection is fixed in 1.24.0; the WebSocket chain requires 1.25.0.

severity.rationale: A network-accessible default installation can execute commands without attacker credentials. The exposed process serves a coding assistant and can reach developer code and data, warranting a 24-hour response.

affected.note: WebSocket flaw affects versions through 1.24.0. The separate Git endpoint flaw affects versions through 1.23.0 and is fixed in 1.24.0.

exposure: Requires network access to the affected UI. The unauthenticated chain depends on the default JWT secret; the Git endpoint issue separately requires authentication. This is a third-party UI, not the Anthropic CLI.

remediation.details: Upgrade Claude Code UI to 1.25.0 or later and configure an explicit strong JWT secret. Updating only to 1.24.0 leaves the WebSocket chain affected.
remediation.risk: Medium. Restart affected sessions and validate dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the running UI is patched, uses an explicit secret and rejects tokens for nonexistent users.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
